title: Generative AI and Large Language Models
text: Generative AI refers to systems that can create new content -- text, images, audio, or code -- rather than just analyzing existing data. Large language models (LLMs), trained on vast amounts of text, are a prominent form of generative AI capable of producing human-like text, answering questions, and assisting with writing and coding. LLMs can occasionally generate plausible-sounding but factually incorrect content, a phenomenon known as hallucination.
